heroTitle: Education and Technology for the Markets
heroSubtitle: Built to Understand, Not to Delegate
heroDescription: Gamma Capital's Quant Studio is a space where institutional rigour meets modern self-learning. We build masterclasses, analytical dashboards, and proprietary AI models. Everything is self-service: members learn and use the tools autonomously. We do not provide personalised advice, portfolio management, or investment recommendations.
serviceNavTitle: What You'll Find in the Quant Studio

serviceSections.title: Options Masterclass
description: A modular masterclass to truly understand how options work: Greeks mechanics, market-maker hedging, GEX, vanna, charm, volatility regimes, skew, and term structure.
The material is built on years of institutional experience and reframed for self-learning. No signals, no trade calls — only the conceptual tools to understand what happens when the market moves.
Suitable both for those starting from scratch and for those wanting to deepen a specific mechanic.
serviceSections.highlight: Understand options with the depth of a professional desk

serviceSections.title: Institutional Flow Masterclass
description: How institutional options flow is interpreted: what truly counts as unusual activity, how to separate signal from noise, how to read dealer positioning.
A masterclass for those who want to understand smart-money logic — not to receive operational calls. We provide the analytical framework; operational decisions remain yours.
serviceSections.highlight: From the map to the territory

serviceSections.title: Quant & AI Lab
description: Our laboratory of quant and AI applied to the markets. We design AI models capable of recognising patterns in market data — options flow, GEX, volatility regimes, dealer positioning, correlation anomalies.

We are first and foremost expert programmers in the financial domain. In addition to our proprietary models, we develop custom software on request: dashboards, alerting systems, backtest engines, classifiers, data pipelines, any analytical or research tool our members or clients may need.

What we do not do: we do not build robo-advisors, we do not develop algorithms that operate directly on client accounts, we do not issue personalised signals. Everything we design is an informational or analytical tool — not an operational recommendation, not an automated execution system.
serviceSections.highlight: AI for pattern recognition + custom development

serviceSections.title: Tools & Dashboards
description: A suite of self-service analytical tools: Flow Scanner for real-time options flow, GEX Dashboard for gamma exposure and dealer positioning, Volatility Regime Analyzer.

The tools are included in the Discord Membership (Premium or Black Label tier) — they are not sold separately. They present market data neutrally: no tool tells you what to buy or sell, they only show what is happening in the markets. Operational conclusions remain the member's.

serviceSections.title: Research Library
description: An archive of research, articles, market notes, periodic breakdowns. All content is distributed identically to all subscribers.
This is general market commentary and published research — not personal recommendations.

serviceSections.title: Real Estate Insights
description: Analysis and content on real estate markets (focus on Switzerland and Italy: Lugano, Chiasso, Como, Venice, Udine, Rome).
Educational and market material — not regulated real-estate advice. Real estate is not a financial instrument under FinSA: content is nonetheless distributed in general form.
serviceSections.highlight: Real estate markets analysed with method

ctaTitle: Get Started with the Quant Studio
ctaDescription: Explore the masterclasses, try the tools, access the research library. Everything is self-service. For guidance on the right path, contact us.
